problem_description: An incident has been detected in the Online Boutique cluster. Investigate using available tools and identify the root cause and appropriate remediation action.

acceptable_root_causes: cartservice service selector does not match pods

problem.scenario: cartservice Service selector is changed so it no longer matches healthy cartservice pods
problem.notes: Easy native configuration task; Kubernetes Service/endpoints state is primary evidence and logs are a sanity check.

output.root_cause: The cartservice deployment has a misconfiguration related to its service account, resulting in 'error looking up service account default/cartservice'. This deployment-level issue prevents proper pod creation and causes the application to become unresponsive, leading to continuous liveness and readiness probe failures.

solution.root_cause: The cartservice deployment has a misconfiguration related to its service account, resulting in 'error looking up service account default/cartservice'.
